def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Colored outline rectangles: fill interior with color 2 for rectangle made from 6,
    # while other hollow figures get a central 7 marking; infer rectangle rule from demo.
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import defaultdict
    pts=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] not in (0,6,8,9,5,3): continue
    # identify closed rectangular frames (horizontal and vertical edges same color), then fill interior
    colors=set(x for row in g for x in row)-{6}
    for col in colors:
      coords=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==col]
      if not coords: continue
      r0=min(r for r,c in coords); r1=max(r for r,c in coords); c0=min(c for r,c in coords); c1=max(c for r,c in coords)
      if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
      # frame only if full perimeter
      if all(g[r0][c]==col and g[r1][c]==col for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(g[r][c0]==col and g[r][c1]==col for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
          for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            if g[r][c]==6: g[r][c]=2
    return g
PY
